text: Bidirectional Kneser-Ney + positional/allograph class + site/object conditioned CLSS seam surgery trained strictly on M77 (1977) corpus improves sign prediction on later-excavated post-1977 Indus inscriptions
Reproduce KN3-Left and KN3-Bidir M77 CV baselines and evaluate CLSS bidirectional seam-surgery model on post-1977 temporal held-out inscriptions in run 2026-10-19-2058

Frozen M77-CLSS (5-zone positional slot-class + bilateral frame grammar + intra-inscription anti-repetition) achieves 20.06% (749/3734) top-1 restoration on 1000 deduplicated post-1977 inscriptions vs KN3-Left 14.70% (549/3734), KN3-Bidir 18.91% (706/3734), KN3-BlanketF 19.47% (727/3734), and 400 SIGIL matched-null controls (max 9.64%, p < 0.0025)
